list.text: Kanto-Johto Magnet Train Line Saffron City Station.
We're trying to enter Silph Co. but there's some invisible barrier blocking the entrance.
We already tried everything, but nothing works.\nIt's too powerful!
Wow! What was that?!
Is that a Pokémon? It seems quite strong, I'll call some backup.
SILPH Corp.
\f[facedad]\bThanks for coming.
\f[facedad]\bCoff! Coff!
\f[facedad]\bI don’t have long. Train’s soon.
\f[facedad]\bI saw those headlines about Kanto and... yeah.
\f[facedad]\bI know you can handle yourself. I know.
\f[facedad]\bI just got a bit worried anyway.
\f[facedad]\bHere. Take this.
\f[facedad]\bSomeone at the office told me you can equip it in a Pokémon, and it can save you from a really bad moment. That’s all.
\f[facedad]\bYou don’t have to use it. Hopefully you don’t.
\f[facedad]\bCoff! Coff!
\f[facedad]\bFor sure, let's take a photo together too!
\f[facedad]\b...Alright. Train’s here.
\f[facedad]\bI'll tell your mom you’re fine.
\f[facedad]\bBe careful, okay?\nBye!
Going into an alley for the first time makes me sorta anxious.
You came from Johto?
You can zip back home by hopping on the Magnet Train.
Chomp... Chew...
The manager of the Power Plant used to be a repairman in a small factory.
Chomp... Chew...
His hard work has taken him up the ladder to eventually become the manager of the Power Plant. \nChew... Gulp...
Quite impressive, don't you think?\nHaaah, I'm full!
The Copycat girl looked unhappy.
She said she lost her cherised Poke Doll--Clefairy.
Our city was feature on a radio show.
It's nice to hear praise for your city, but it's a bit embarrassing, too.
Everyone Is Welcome!\nFighting Dojo
Don't Call Me Uncle Psychic!\nMr. Psychic's House

then.text: There's a strong psychic barrier blocking the entrance.
Would you like to use the Silph Scope on it?

branches.text: The psychic barrier is now gone.

then.text: I went to the Gym, raring for battles against Trainers...
It turns out, I stumbled into the unused Gym next door.\nBoy, I was pretty embarrassed.
Kanto needed strength. Maybe Giovanni in charge is what it takes to fix things.
The Pokémon Association Election is happening right now  in Celadon, I'll be going there in a few minutes!
The Pokémon Association Elections will happen soon.\nI don't even know who are the candidates yet, hope it's someone with a lot of experience!

list.text: This is Silph Co., famous for Pokemon merchandise.
In the past, team Rocket wanted the company because of that.

\f[faceyellow]\rHey, \PN!
\f[faceyellow]\rYou and Red did it! Now Kanto can finally start healing.
\f[faceyellow]\rThe Gym challenge can continue properly now.

then.text: \f[faceyellow]\rYou already have all the Kanto Badges, right?\nSo you can face the Elite Four again.

else.text: \f[faceyellow]\rYou already have most of the badges, right?\nJust need to finish up and face the Elite Four.

list.text: \f[faceyellow]\rThough I should mention...\nthe Elite Four has undergone some changes after everything that's happened.
\f[faceyellow]\rSome familiar faces stepped up to restore balance to the League.
\f[faceyellow]\rI'm sure they're much stronger than the last time you faced them.
\f[faceyellow]\rI should get going now! Please call me anytime!\nGood luck!
